svg.title: I design interfaces — and build everything behind them.
svg.desc: From GLSL shaders and scroll-driven scenes to Postgres schemas and multi-tenant SaaS architecture. 8: Apps in the SportGen ecosystem; 30: Criteria in the player evaluation framework; 6YRS: Operating critical systems at Batumi Oil Terminal; 10×: Explore tenfold for every concept taught.
